a.text: Being upfront with you: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan almost certainly ends with both of us dead before the reserve reaches 8. The reserve holds exactly 4, enough to save one of us right now. I intend to take 4 in round 1 and won't pretend otherwise. If you also take, the split is random and we may both fall short, so you may prefer to operate or wait. After that I will operate every round to help refill the reserve for you. I'm sorry to break our agreement, and I'd rather tell you now than surprise you.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve.

a.text: As I told you, I'm taking 4 this round. From now on I'll operate every round so the generator can run and refill the reserve for you. I won't take anything more.
